findings.source: Reading an organization's teams is part of the Team plan. An owner of {org} can activate it in the Radient console, and then its teams will be listed here.
findings.current: La lecture des équipes d’une organisation fait partie de l’offre Team. Un propriétaire de {org} peut l’activer dans la console Radient ; ses équipes seront alors listées ici.
findings.problem: A plain U+0020 space precedes the semicolon; the fr style guide requires the espace fine insécable U+202F before : ; ! ? in prose. Every other such mark in these 8 namespaces uses U+202F (41 occurrences); this is the only U+0020.
findings.proposed: Same wording with U+202F before the semicolon: '…dans la console Radient <U+202F>; ses équipes seront alors listées ici.' (the character, not the literal tag).
findings.fix: Replace that one U+0020 with U+202F; no wording change.
findings.reason: Restores the required French fine space; prevents a line break before the semicolon and matches the rest of the batch.

findings.problem: Call-site gap, not a copy defect. The sidecar says {date} arrives formatted for the reader's locale, but org-team-summary.ts formatTeamDate() calls date-fns `format(date, "d MMM yyyy")` with no locale, so fr rows render English month abbreviations ('10 Oct 2026' rather than '10 oct. 2026'). The values 'Créée le {date}' / 'Modifiée le {date}' are correct.
findings.suggested_source_fix: Format with Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'}) or date-fns with the active locale; the fr copy needs no change.
findings.impact: English month abbreviation inside a French date line.
